# 实施方案: W28T3

## 任务概述

| 字段 | 值 |
|------|-----|
| Wave | W28 — Benchmarks |
| Task | W28T3 — Element-wise math benchmarks: add/sub/mul/div/sin/exp/abs (f32/f64/Complex<f64>, contiguous + non-contiguous) |
| 目标文件 | `benches/math.rs` |
| 前置依赖 | W28T2 |
| 设计文档 | 27-benchmark.md |
| 预估工时 | 25 min |

## 目标

Element-wise math benchmarks: add/sub/mul/div/sin/exp/abs (f32/f64/Complex<f64>, contiguous + non-contiguous)。

本任务建立 W28 benchmark 交付物的一部分，覆盖 27-benchmark §5 的 benchmark 结构、§5.5 的清单、§6 的数值与执行约束，以及 §8 的 quick smoke 验证口径。涉及的 benchmark 或检查项为：`elem_add_f64`, `elem_add_f32`, `elem_add_complex`, `elem_mul_f64`, `elem_sin_f64`, `elem_sin_f32`, `elem_sub_f64`, `elem_div_f64`, `elem_exp_f64`, `elem_abs_f64`, `elem_add_sliced`。

## 前置准备

- 确认 W28 之前的核心 API、错误语义、构造、广播、归约、矩阵、SIMD 或并行相关任务已按前置依赖完成。
- 使用仓库现有依赖，不为 benchmark 引入新的第三方测量框架。
- 仅在目标文件内添加 benchmark、辅助函数或 CI/report 逻辑，避免改变 crate 公共 API。

## 实施步骤

### Step 1: 建立目标文件骨架

按 27-benchmark §5.1 和 §5.8 的 `harness = false` 模式创建或更新目标文件，保留 `--quick` 与名称 filter 入口，确保单个 bench 可独立运行。

```rust
use std::hint::black_box;
use std::time::Instant;

mod utils;
use utils::{generators, SIZES_1D};

const WARMUP_ITERATIONS: usize = 10;
const ROUNDS: usize = 10;
const ITERATIONS_PER_ROUND: usize = 100;

fn run_timed<F>(quick: bool, mut operation: F) -> u128
where
    F: FnMut(),
{
    let (rounds, iterations) = if quick { (1, 10) } else { (ROUNDS, ITERATIONS_PER_ROUND) };
    for _ in 0..WARMUP_ITERATIONS {
        operation();
    }
    let mut timings = Vec::with_capacity(rounds);
    for _round in 0..rounds {
        let started_at = Instant::now();
        for _iteration in 0..iterations {
            operation();
        }
        timings.push(started_at.elapsed().as_nanos());
    }
    timings.sort_unstable();
    timings[timings.len() / 2]
}

// --- f64 contiguous benches ---

fn bench_elem_add_f64(quick: bool) {
    for &size in SIZES_1D {
        let lhs = generators::sequential_1d(size);
        let rhs = generators::sequential_1d(size);
        let median = run_timed(quick, || {
            let _result = black_box((&lhs + &rhs).expect("same-shape add must succeed"));
        });
        println!("elem_add_f64/{size}: {median} ns");
    }
}

fn bench_elem_sub_f64(quick: bool) {
    for &size in SIZES_1D {
        let lhs = generators::sequential_1d(size);
        let rhs = generators::sequential_1d(size);
        let median = run_timed(quick, || {
            let _result = black_box((&lhs - &rhs).expect("same-shape sub must succeed"));
        });
        println!("elem_sub_f64/{size}: {median} ns");
    }
}

fn bench_elem_mul_f64(quick: bool) {
    for &size in SIZES_1D {
        let lhs = generators::sequential_1d(size);
        let rhs = generators::sequential_1d(size);
        let median = run_timed(quick, || {
            let _result = black_box((&lhs * &rhs).expect("same-shape mul must succeed"));
        });
        println!("elem_mul_f64/{size}: {median} ns");
    }
}

fn bench_elem_div_f64(quick: bool) {
    for &size in SIZES_1D {
        let lhs = generators::sequential_1d(size);
        let rhs = generators::sequential_1d(size);
        let median = run_timed(quick, || {
            let _result = black_box((&lhs / &rhs).expect("same-shape div must succeed"));
        });
        println!("elem_div_f64/{size}: {median} ns");
    }
}

fn bench_elem_abs_f64(quick: bool) {
    for &size in SIZES_1D {
        let lhs = generators::sequential_1d(size);
        let median = run_timed(quick, || {
            let _result = black_box(lhs.map(|&x| x.abs()));
        });
        println!("elem_abs_f64/{size}: {median} ns");
    }
}

fn bench_elem_sin_f64(quick: bool) {
    for &size in SIZES_1D {
        let lhs = generators::sequential_1d(size);
        let median = run_timed(quick, || {
            let _result = black_box(lhs.map(|&x| x.sin()));
        });
        println!("elem_sin_f64/{size}: {median} ns");
    }
}

fn bench_elem_exp_f64(quick: bool) {
    for &size in SIZES_1D {
        let lhs = generators::sequential_1d(size);
        let median = run_timed(quick, || {
            let _result = black_box(lhs.map(|&x| x.exp()));
        });
        println!("elem_exp_f64/{size}: {median} ns");
    }
}

// --- f32 benches ---

fn bench_elem_add_f32(quick: bool) {
    for &size in SIZES_1D {
        let lhs = Tensor1::<f32>::from_shape_vec(
            [size],
            (0..size).map(|idx| idx as f32).collect(),
        ).expect("shape and data length must match");
        let rhs = Tensor1::<f32>::from_shape_vec(
            [size],
            (0..size).map(|idx| idx as f32).collect(),
        ).expect("shape and data length must match");
        let median = run_timed(quick, || {
            let _result = black_box((&lhs + &rhs).expect("same-shape add must succeed"));
        });
        println!("elem_add_f32/{size}: {median} ns");
    }
}

fn bench_elem_sin_f32(quick: bool) {
    for &size in SIZES_1D {
        let lhs = Tensor1::<f32>::from_shape_vec(
            [size],
            (0..size).map(|idx| idx as f32).collect(),
        ).expect("shape and data length must match");
        let median = run_timed(quick, || {
            let _result = black_box(lhs.map(|&x| x.sin()));
        });
        println!("elem_sin_f32/{size}: {median} ns");
    }
}

// --- Complex<f64> bench ---

fn bench_elem_add_complex(quick: bool) {
    for &size in SIZES_1D {
        let lhs = generators::complex_1d(size);
        let rhs = generators::complex_1d(size);
        let median = run_timed(quick, || {
            let _result = black_box((&lhs + &rhs).expect("same-shape add must succeed"));
        });
        println!("elem_add_complex/{size}: {median} ns");
    }
}

// --- non-contiguous (sliced) bench ---

fn bench_elem_add_sliced(quick: bool) {
    for &size in SIZES_1D {
        let lhs_sliced = generators::strided_view_1d(size);
        let rhs = generators::sequential_1d(size);
        let median = run_timed(quick, || {
            let _result = black_box((&lhs_sliced + &rhs).expect("broadcast-compatible add must succeed"));
        });
        println!("elem_add_sliced/{size}: {median} ns");
    }
}

// --- main dispatch ---

fn should_run(filter: Option<&str>, name: &str) -> bool {
    filter.map_or(true, |needle| name.contains(needle))
}

fn main() {
    let args = std::env::args().skip(1).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let quick = args.iter().any(|arg| arg == "--quick");
    let filter = args.iter().find(|arg| !arg.starts_with("--")).map(String::as_str);

    let benches: &[(&str, fn(bool))] = &[
        ("elem_add_f64", bench_elem_add_f64),
        ("elem_sub_f64", bench_elem_sub_f64),
        ("elem_mul_f64", bench_elem_mul_f64),
        ("elem_div_f64", bench_elem_div_f64),
        ("elem_abs_f64", bench_elem_abs_f64),
        ("elem_sin_f64", bench_elem_sin_f64),
        ("elem_exp_f64", bench_elem_exp_f64),
        ("elem_add_f32", bench_elem_add_f32),
        ("elem_sin_f32", bench_elem_sin_f32),
        ("elem_add_complex", bench_elem_add_complex),
        ("elem_add_sliced", bench_elem_add_sliced),
    ];

    for &(name, func) in benches {
        if should_run(filter, name) {
            func(quick);
        }
    }
}ch_elem_add_f64(quick);
    }
}
```

### Step 2: 覆盖 benchmark 参数矩阵

将本任务范围内的条目映射到 27-benchmark §5.4 的 Small/Medium/Large 输入规模，并用 `std::hint::black_box` 包裹被测操作。quick 模式只运行最小轮数；完整模式保留多轮 median 输出。

```rust
fn selected_sizes(quick: bool) -> &'static [usize] {
    if quick { &[64] } else { &[64, 65_536, 16_777_216] }
}

fn print_result(name: &str, size: usize, median_ns: u128) {
    println!("{name}/{size}: {median_ns} ns");
}
```

### Step 3: 单元测试

> **强制要求**:
> - 本步骤必须包含一个或者多个单元测试。
> - 测试函数名称和测试内容必须参考对应设计文档的 **「测试计划」** 一节。
> - 编译检查与Lint检查不等同于单元测试。
> - 如果测试没有通过需要修复直至测试通过。
> - **无测试 = 任务未完成。**

```rust
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_filter_runs_matching_benchmark() {
        assert!(should_run(Some("elem"), "elem_add_f64"));
        assert!(!should_run(Some("missing"), "elem_add_f64"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_quick_mode_uses_single_round() {
        let mut calls = 0usize;
        let median = run_timed(true, || calls += 1);
        assert!(median <= u128::MAX);
        assert!(calls >= WARMUP_ITERATIONS + 10);
    }
}
```

## 关键设计决策

| 决策 | 依据 |
|------|------|
| 使用仓库本地 `harness = false` runner，而非 Criterion 等第三方框架 | 27-benchmark §11 决策 1 要求不引入额外 benchmark 框架 |
| quick 模式保留 filter 与最小输入规模 | 27-benchmark §5.6 和 §8.1 要求 CI smoke 可快速验证 benchmark 入口 |
| benchmark 只记录性能趋势，不定义功能正确性合约 | 27-benchmark §1.1 将功能正确性边界交给 28-tests |

## 验证方式

1. 编译检查: `cargo check --benches`
2. Lint 检查: `cargo clippy --benches -- -D warnings`
3. 测试验证: `cargo bench --bench math -- elem_add_f64 --quick`
4. 手动验证: 运行对应 bench 的 `--quick` filter，确认输出包含本任务的 benchmark 名称和 median ns 数值。

## 注意事项

- `black_box` 必须包裹被测结果，避免编译器消除热路径。
- benchmark 输入生成应固定、可重复，避免随机噪声污染趋势判断。
- SIMD/并行对比只在对应 feature 组合下解释性能差异，不得改变默认 API 行为。
